title: Low-stock report
hints: Think of it as three steps chained together: keep the low ones → put them in order → turn each into a string.

`sort` mutates, and the input is `readonly`. But `filter` already returns a brand-new array, so sorting *after* filtering is safe. For the comparator: `a.stock - b.stock || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)`.
In the `map`, choose the status text first: "out of stock" when `p.stock === 0`, otherwise `${p.stock} left`. Then return `${p.sku} ${p.name} (${status})`.
